items.stem: Which TWO reflect good on-page SEO practice? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Match the page content to the query's search intent
options.rationale: Correct: intent match is central to ranking.

options.text: Use a clear, descriptive title and headings
options.rationale: Correct: structured, descriptive metadata helps users and engines.

options.text: Repeat the keyword as many times as possible
